name: Two Can Play at This Game
source:
"Two Can Play at This Game" follows the lives of robotics engineer X2-0, and robotics software developer HL - two lovers working in tandem with private investors for The State government to produce a working prototype of a Girlfriend Robot. A project of high importance intended to lead to the revolutionary restoration of an otherwise broken society. As the robot, LYNDA, enters her testing phase, X2-0 despairs for the state of the couple's already crumbling relationship. Will X2-0 be able to convince HL that her love as a human can surpass that of the perfect vision of an AI? Or will her fear be realised of being replaced entirely?

[From [url=https://pscfunzone.itch.io/two-can-play-at-this-game]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《两个人可以玩这个游戏》讲述了机器人工程师X2-0和机器人软件开发人员HL的生活，这两位恋人与私人投资者合作，为州政府生产女朋友机器人的工作原型。这是一个非常重要的项目，旨在为一个破碎的社会带来革命性的恢复。当机器人LYNDA进入测试阶段时，X2-0对这对夫妇已经摇摇欲坠的关系感到绝望。X2-0能否让HL相信她作为人类的爱可以超越人工智能的完美视觉？或者她担心被完全取代的恐惧会成为现实吗？

[来自[url=https://pscfunzone.itch.io/two-can-play-at-this-game]itch.io[/url]]
